name: What is the process for main line backup repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for main line backup repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our main line backup repair process begins with a diagnostic inspection, often using a sewer camera, to pinpoint the exact location and cause of the blockage or damage. Once identified, we determine the most appropriate repair method, which could range from hydro-jetting to clear obstructions to trenchless pipe repair or traditional excavation for severe damage. We prioritize methods that minimize disruption to your property. After the repair, we conduct a final inspection to ensure the line is clear and functioning properly.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves diagnostic inspection, identifying the cause, choosing the best repair method (e.g., hydro-jetting or excavation), and a final check.
